source.original_question:

adaptations.reason: Decorative photograph, person, tree or building texture removed; the mathematical segments, endpoints, measurements, directions and source layout are reconstructed natively.

independent_solution.method: The small triangle has ground length30-25=5 and height1.5. Similarity gives lamp height1.5*30/5=9m.
